hook.en: Converting octal to hexadecimal through decimal is long. Since 8 and 16 are both powers of 2, binary gives us a shortcut. Let us find it.
hook.kn: ಅಷ್ಟಮಾನದಿಂದ ಷೋಡಶಮಾನಕ್ಕೆ ದಶಮಾನದ ಮೂಲಕ ಬದಲಿಸುವುದು ದೀರ್ಘ. 8 ಮತ್ತು 16 ಎರಡೂ 2 ರ ಘಾತಗಳಾದ್ದರಿಂದ ದ್ವಿಮಾನ ಶಾರ್ಟ್‌ಕಟ್ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Convert binary to octal and hexadecimal by grouping bits
Convert octal and hexadecimal to binary
Convert octal to hexadecimal through binary

narration.en: Converting octal to hexadecimal through decimal is long. Since 8 and 16 are both powers of 2, binary gives us a shortcut. Let us find it.
narration.kn: ಅಷ್ಟಮಾನದಿಂದ ಷೋಡಶಮಾನಕ್ಕೆ ದಶಮಾನದ ಮೂಲಕ ಬದಲಿಸುವುದು ದೀರ್ಘ. 8 ಮತ್ತು 16 ಎರಡೂ 2 ರ ಘಾತಗಳಾದ್ದರಿಂದ ದ್ವಿಮಾನ ಶಾರ್ಟ್‌ಕಟ್ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Binary to octal: starting from the binary point, make groups of 3 bits (add 0s on the left if needed) and replace each group by its octal digit. Binary to hexadecimal: make groups of 4 bits and replace each by its hex digit. Going back, write each octal digit as 3 bits or each hex digit as 4 bits. To go from octal to hexadecimal (or back), first convert to binary and then regroup.

points.en: Group from the binary point outwards; pad with 0s

To go from octal to hexadecimal (or back), first convert to binary and then regroup.
narration.kn: ದ್ವಿಮಾನದಿಂದ ಅಷ್ಟಮಾನಕ್ಕೆ: ಬಲದಿಂದ 3 ಬಿಟ್‌ಗಳ ಗುಂಪು ಮಾಡಿ. ಷೋಡಶಮಾನಕ್ಕೆ: 4 ಬಿಟ್‌ಗಳ ಗುಂಪು. ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಲು ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಷ್ಟಮಾನ ಅಂಕಿಯನ್ನು 3 ಬಿಟ್‌ಗಳಾಗಿ, ಷೋಡಶಮಾನ ಅಂಕಿಯನ್ನು 4 ಬಿಟ್‌ಗಳಾಗಿ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ. ಅಷ್ಟಮಾನದಿಂದ ಷೋಡಶಮಾನಕ್ಕೆ ದ್ವಿಮಾನದ ಮೂಲಕ ಹೋಗಿ.

title.en: On the board: Grouping bits for octal and hexadecimal

say.en: One octal digit is 3 bits. Starting at the right, split 1101011 into groups of three, padding the left with zeros.
Replace each group by its value: 1, 5, 3. So 1101011 is 153 in octal.
One hex digit is 4 bits. Make groups of four from the right instead.
The groups are 6 and 11, and 11 is B. So it is 6B in hexadecimal, and both are 107 in decimal.
To go back, write each octal digit as 3 bits or each hex digit as 4 bits. Octal to hex goes through binary.

narration.en: We convert 1101011 to octal by groups of three bits and to hexadecimal by groups of four bits.

problem.en: Convert (11010111)₂ to octal and to hexadecimal.

steps.en: Octal: group in threes from the right: 011 | 010 | 111 → 3 | 2 | 7.

steps.en: Write each octal digit as 3 bits: 1 → 001, 2 → 010, 7 → 111, giving 001010111.
Regroup in fours from the right: 0000 | 0101 | 0111.

body.en: Octal has 8 = 2³ symbols, so 3 bits per digit. Hex has 16 = 2⁴ symbols, so 4 bits per digit. The power of 2 is the group size.

narration.en: Octal 3, Hex 4. Octal has 8 = 2³ symbols, so 3 bits per digit. Hex has 16 = 2⁴ symbols, so 4 bits per digit. The power of 2 is the group size.

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ದ್ವಿಮಾನದಿಂದ ಅಷ್ಟಮಾನಕ್ಕೆ 3 ರ ಗುಂಪು; ಷೋಡಶಮಾನಕ್ಕೆ 4 ರ ಗುಂಪು. ಬಿಂದುವಿನಿಂದ ಗುಂಪು ಮಾಡಿ, ಸೊನ್ನೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ. ಅಷ್ಟಮಾನ ↔ ಷೋಡಶಮಾನ ದ್ವಿಮಾನದ ಮೂಲಕ.
